correctness.rationale: Exact tangent-intersection determinant gives A=(b-a)(c-b)(c-a)/4; its unique maximizer is (-1,0,1). The nonnegative deficit identity localizes all rare configurations; scaling two endpoint gaps by epsilon and central displacement by sqrt(epsilon), the beta–Jacobi density converges with an integrable monomial majorant. The gamma simplex integral yields K_(p,q), and L1 convergence gives joint total variation and Dirichlet marks. The included independent intersection-area and finite-threshold quadrature checker passed for three parameter pairs.

value.rationale: The parameter family interpolates between concentration/repulsion at both window endpoints and at the uniquely optimal central tangency, giving an exact tunable exponent 2p+q/2 and an explicit full conditional Dirichlet law. This separates two geometrically meaningful rare-event approach scales and supplies an interpretable benchmark for nonuniform sampling of tangent arrangements, not an arbitrary single-parameter constant.
